description: Generate the complete astro-beginner-static-site starter with exact-pinned Astro scaffold, plain CSS, project-local pnpm manifest/lockfile, starter.json, .gitignore, shared layout/navigation/footer, two reusable components, public assets, SiteConfig, SEO/sitemap config, beginner comments, .env.example (comment-only), four static pages (Home, About, Contact with mailto:, Projects), tests (link/route, viewport overflow, keyboard/focus, accessibility, dependency-allowlist, Property 14), full README documentation, and one-shot validation commands.
steps: Create astro-beginner-static-site/ directory as a direct child of repository root

Create package.json with name 'astro-beginner-static-site', type 'module', exact-pinned astro dependency (5.18.2), @astrojs/sitemap (3.7.3), plain CSS (NO Tailwind), packageManager field 'pnpm@10.28.1'. Runtime deps limited to: astro, @astrojs/sitemap. Dev deps: @astrojs/check, @eslint/js, @playwright/test, @axe-core/playwright, cheerio, eslint, eslint-plugin-astro, fast-check, globals, typescript, typescript-eslint, vitest. Scripts: dev, build, check, lint, test (unit), test:output (output), test:all, validate (lint && check && build && test:all)
Create pnpm-lock.yaml by running pnpm install in the starter directory
Create tsconfig.json extending 'astro/tsconfigs/strict'
Create astro.config.mjs with output:'static', site:'https://example.com', integrations:[sitemap()]. Include a beginner comment explaining static output setting.
Create eslint.config.mjs following the astro-adsense-blog pattern (eslint recommended + typescript-eslint + eslint-plugin-astro + globals)
Create vitest.config.ts with test include: ['tests/**/*.test.ts']
Create .gitignore: node_modules, dist, .astro, .env, .env.* (with !.env.example exception)

Create starter.json matching catalog entry id:51 - folder:'astro-beginner-static-site', family:'Beginner Static', useCase:'Very simple beginner static site', framework:'Astro', runtime:'Node LTS', technologies, choices:'plain CSS', auth:'None', data:'local TS/Markdown', monetization:'None', integrations:[]
Create src/config.ts with a SiteConfig object (siteName, siteUrl, description, author, contactEmail as 'your-email@example.com')

Create src/layouts/BaseLayout.astro with semantic HTML, head with SEO meta tags (title, description, canonical, viewport), navigation header, main slot, footer. Include a beginner comment block explaining the root layout purpose and slot usage.

Create src/components/Navigation.astro with semantic nav element, links to Home/About/Projects/Contact, keyboard-operable, visible focus indicators. Include a beginner comment explaining the reusable component pattern.
Create src/components/Footer.astro with semantic footer, copyright year, site name from config
Create src/components/Card.astro - reusable content card component for projects/features listing
Create src/components/Hero.astro - reusable hero/banner section component
Create public/favicon.svg - simple SVG favicon
Create src/pages/index.astro - Home page using BaseLayout, Hero component, intro content
Create src/pages/about.astro - About page with personal/team info placeholder
Create src/pages/contact.astro - Contact page with replaceable mailto: link using config.contactEmail. No actual form submission.
Create src/pages/projects.astro - Projects page using Card component for project listings
Create .env.example as comment-only file declaring no required values (per Requirement 7.1/7.2 - zero external services)
Create src/styles/global.css with responsive plain CSS: mobile-first, readable content, navigation styles, focus indicators (:focus-visible), no horizontal overflow at mobile/tablet/desktop viewports
Create tests/unit/dependency-allowlist.test.ts - Property 14 test verifying every runtime dep maps to framework/styling/SEO/sitemap/static-output. Uses fast-check for property testing.
Create tests/output/links.test.ts - built-output link/route validation crawling dist/ for broken internal links (following astro-adsense-blog/tests/output/links.test.ts pattern)
Create tests/output/accessibility.test.ts - axe-core Playwright tests checking all pages for serious/critical WCAG violations
Create tests/output/overflow.test.ts - viewport overflow tests at mobile (375px), tablet (768px), desktop (1280px) checking no horizontal scroll on any page
Create tests/output/keyboard-focus.test.ts - keyboard navigation and focus indicator tests using Playwright, verifying all nav links are keyboard-operable with visible focus

Create README.md documenting: folder structure, reusable components, content editing, plain CSS styling, every runtime dependency purpose mapping, local validation commands, static build/export, deployment to Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages, supported runtime versions
acceptance_criteria: pnpm lint passes with zero errors
pnpm check (astro check) passes with zero errors
pnpm build produces dist/ with static HTML files for all 4 pages plus sitemap.xml
pnpm test (unit tests) pass including Property 14 dependency allowlist
pnpm test:output passes all Playwright-based built-output tests (links, accessibility, overflow, keyboard-focus)
starter.json matches catalog entry id:51 exactly
Zero external services, authentication, database, or payment configuration required
All pages render without horizontal overflow at 375px, 768px, and 1280px viewports
Navigation is keyboard-operable with visible focus indicators
Contact page uses replaceable mailto: link (no form submission)
Beginner comments present at root layout, one component, and astro.config.mjs static output
README documents Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages deployment
README lists every runtime dependency with mapping to allowed capability
findings: Fixed color-contrast accessibility violations by using #595959 instead of #718096 for muted text. Fixed link-in-text-block violations by ensuring all links in text blocks use text-decoration:underline. Fixed fast-check property test by using Object.hasOwn() instead of 'in' operator to avoid prototype chain false positives. Playwright browsers need manual install (npx playwright install chromium) before output tests. All 25 tests pass. Build produces 4 HTML pages + sitemap-index.xml.
